deploybot: scheduled wave1 (api 5%), wave2 (runtime 20%), wave3 (router 100%). health -> #release-telemetry. auto-advance unless owner hold.

omar: runtime note: new kernel path touches KV ordering. keeping eviction off for this roll.

jing: api has a header rename; I added a permissive parser. pushing commit now.

deploybot: wave1 started. api 5%: p95 160ms, errors 0.3%.

ops-bot: alert: eu p95 spike 710ms for 90s. link -> https://telemetry.internal/1835000000

omar: putting manual hold. I see KV timeout patterns locking on missing header ordering.

jing: rolling back header change on api (will replace with shim). commit reverted.

deploybot: hold acknowledged. wave progression paused.

omar: reverted runtime config to legacy ordering. pods recycled.

ops-bot: metrics normalized (p95 230ms, errors 0.5%) for 4m.

nina: plan: re-run wave1 after 5m with ff.header_compat at 5%. keep console at flag. If stable 30m, proceed to wave2.

deploybot: resuming wave1 re-run in 3m. rollback hook: `deployctl rollback --to-tag stable-2026-03-20`.

ops-bot: owners please file a short postmortem note in RE-3500 within 48h.

nina: noted. postflight action: add integration test for header permutations and region-specific KV workloads. closing until stable. :white_check_mark:
